surah.personality_title: Surah As-Saaffaat (Those drawn up in Ranks)
surah.personality_summary: Unique Qur'anic surah of 182 ayat revealed in Mecca, possessing its distinct thematic core, atmosphere, and rhetorical progression.
surah.opening_ending_dynamic: Connects opening theme to terminal resolution.
surah.overview: Surah As-Saaffaat (Those drawn up in Ranks) is the 37th surah in the canonical muṣḥaf sequence, comprising 182 ayat. Classified as Makki.

ayahs.arabic_simple: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ وَالصَّافَّاتِ صَفًّا
ayahs.arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم والصافات صفا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: By those [angels] lined up in rows
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: By those [angels] ranged in rows

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And those who drive [the clouds]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: who rebuke reproachfully

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And those who recite the message
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and recite God’s word

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed, your God is One
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: truly your God is One

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا وَرَبُّ ٱلۡمَشَٰرِقِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَرَبُّ الْمَشَارِقِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: رب السماوات والارض وما بينهما ورب المشارق
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Lord of the heavens and the earth and that between them and Lord of the sunrises
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Lord of the heavens and earth and everything between them, Lord of every sunrise

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: إِنَّا زَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنۡيَا بِزِينَةٍ ٱلۡكَوَاكِبِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: إِنَّا زَيَّنَّا السَّمَاءَ الدُّنْيَا بِزِينَةٍ الْكَوَاكِبِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: انا زينا السماء الدنيا بزينة الكواكب
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed, We have adorned the nearest heaven with an adornment of stars
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: We have adorned the lowest heaven with stars

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَحِفۡظࣰ ا مِّن كُلِّ شَيۡطَٰنࣲ مَّارِدࣲ‏
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And as protection against every rebellious devil
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and made them a safeguard against every rebellious devil

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: لَّا يَسَّمَّعُونَ إِلَى ٱلۡمَلَإِ ٱلۡأَعۡلَىٰ وَيُقۡذَفُونَ مِن كُلِّ جَانِبࣲ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: لَا يَسَّمَّعُونَ إِلَى الْمَلَإِ الْأَعْلَىٰ وَيُقْذَفُونَ مِنْ كُلِّ جَانِبٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: لا يسمعون الى الملا الاعلى ويقذفون من كل جانب
ayahs.translation_saheeh: [So] they may not listen to the exalted assembly [of angels] and are pelted from every side
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: they cannot eavesdrop on the Higher Assembly––pelted from every side

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Repelled; and for them is a constant punishment
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: driven away, they will have perpetual torment––

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: إِلَّا مَنۡ خَطِفَ ٱلۡخَطۡفَةَ فَأَتۡبَعَهُۥ شِهَابࣱ ثَاقِبࣱ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: إِلَّا مَنْ خَطِفَ الْخَطْفَةَ فَأَتْبَعَهُ شِهَابٌ ثَاقِبٌ
ayahs.arabic_clean: الا من خطف الخطفة فاتبعه شهاب ثاقب
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Except one who snatches [some words] by theft, but they are pursued by a burning flame, piercing [in brightness]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: if any [of them] stealthily snatches away a fragment, he will be pursued by a piercing flame

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فَٱسۡتَفۡتِهِمۡ أَهُمۡ أَشَدُّ خَلۡقًا أَم مَّنۡ خَلَقۡنَآۚ إِنَّا خَلَقۡنَٰهُم مِّن طِينࣲ لَّازِبِۭ
ayahs.arabic_simple: فَاسْتَفْتِهِمْ أَهُمْ أَشَدُّ خَلْقًا أَمْ مَنْ خَلَقْنَا ۚ إِنَّا خَلَقْنَاهُمْ مِنْ طِينٍ لَازِبٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: فاستفتهم اهم اشد خلقا ام من خلقنا ۚ انا خلقناهم من طين لازب
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Then inquire of them, [O Muhammad], "Are they a stronger [or more difficult] creation or those [others] We have created?" Indeed, We created men from sticky clay
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: So [Prophet], ask the disbelievers: is it harder to create them than other beings We have created? We created them from sticky clay

ayahs.translation_saheeh: But you wonder, while they mock
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: You marvel as they scoff

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And when they are reminded, they remember not
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: take no heed when they are warned

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And when they see a sign, they ridicule
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and resort to ridicule when they see a sign

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَقَالُوٓاْ إِنۡ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحۡرࣱ مُّبِينٌ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَقَالُوا إِنْ هَٰذَا إِلَّا سِحْرٌ مُبِينٌ
ayahs.arabic_clean: وقالوا ان هذا الا سحر مبين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And say, "This is not but obvious magic
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: saying, ‘This is no more than blatant sorcery.’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: أَءِذَا مِتۡنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابࣰ ا وَعِظَٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبۡعُوثُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: أَإِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَعِظَامًا أَإِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ااذا متنا وكنا ترابا وعظاما اانا لمبعوثون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: When we have died and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: ‘What! After we have died and become dust and bones, shall we really be raised up again

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And our forefathers [as well]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: along with our forefathers?’

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Say, "Yes, and you will be [rendered] contemptible
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Say, ‘Yes indeed, and you will be humiliated.’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فَإِنَّمَا هِيَ زَجۡرَةࣱ وَٰحِدَةࣱ فَإِذَا هُمۡ يَنظُرُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: فَإِنَّمَا هِيَ زَجْرَةٌ وَاحِدَةٌ فَإِذَا هُمْ يَنْظُرُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: فانما هي زجرة واحدة فاذا هم ينظرون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: It will be only one shout, and at once they will be observing
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Just one blast and––lo and behold!––they will look

ayahs.arabic_simple: وَقَالُوا يَا وَيْلَنَا هَٰذَا يَوْمُ الدِّينِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: وقالوا يا ويلنا هذا يوم الدين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: They will say, "O woe to us! This is the Day of Recompense
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and say, ‘Woe to us! This is the Day of Judgement.’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: هَٰذَا يَوۡمُ ٱلۡفَصۡلِ ٱلَّذِي كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: هَٰذَا يَوْمُ الْفَصْلِ الَّذِي كُنْتُمْ بِهِ تُكَذِّبُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: هذا يوم الفصل الذي كنتم به تكذبون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: [They will be told], "This is the Day of Judgement which you used to deny
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: [It will be said], ‘This is the Day of Decision, which you used to deny

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: ۞ٱحۡشُرُواْ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ وَأَزۡوَٰجَهُمۡ وَمَا كَانُواْ يَعۡبُدُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: ۞ احْشُرُوا الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا وَأَزْوَاجَهُمْ وَمَا كَانُوا يَعْبُدُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ۞ احشروا الذين ظلموا وازواجهم وما كانوا يعبدون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: [The angels will be ordered], "Gather those who committed wrong, their kinds, and what they used to worship
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: [Angels], gather together those who did wrong, and others like them, as well as whatever they worshipped

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ فَٱهۡدُوهُمۡ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطِ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ فَاهْدُوهُمْ إِلَىٰ صِرَاطِ الْجَحِيمِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: من دون الله فاهدوهم الى صراط الجحيم
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Other than Allah, and guide them to the path of Hellfire
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: beside God, lead them all to the path of Hell

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And stop them; indeed, they are to be questioned
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and halt them for questioning

ayahs.translation_saheeh: [They will be asked], "What is [wrong] with you? Why do you not help each other
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: “Why do you not support each other now?” ’––

ayahs.translation_saheeh: But they, that Day, are in surrender
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: no indeed! They will be in complete submission on that Day––

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And they will approach one another blaming each other
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and they will turn on one another accusingly

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّكُمۡ كُنتُمۡ تَأۡتُونَنَا عَنِ ٱلۡيَمِينِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: قَالُوا إِنَّكُمْ كُنْتُمْ تَأْتُونَنَا عَنِ الْيَمِينِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: قالوا انكم كنتم تاتوننا عن اليمين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: They will say, "Indeed, you used to come at us from the right
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: They will say, ‘You came to us from a position of power.’

ayahs.translation_saheeh: The oppressors will say, "Rather, you [yourselves] were not believers
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: They will say, ‘No! It was you who would not believe

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَمَا كَانَ لَنَا عَلَيۡكُم مِّن سُلۡطَٰنِۭۖ بَلۡ كُنتُمۡ قَوۡمࣰ ا طَٰغِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَمَا كَانَ لَنَا عَلَيْكُمْ مِنْ سُلْطَانٍ ۖ بَلْ كُنْتُمْ قَوْمًا طَاغِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: وما كان لنا عليكم من سلطان ۖ بل كنتم قوما طاغين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And we had over you no authority, but you were a transgressing people
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: we had no power over you- and you were already exceeding all limits

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فَحَقَّ عَلَيۡنَا قَوۡلُ رَبِّنَآۖ إِنَّا لَذَآئِقُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: فَحَقَّ عَلَيْنَا قَوْلُ رَبِّنَا ۖ إِنَّا لَذَائِقُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: فحق علينا قول ربنا ۖ انا لذائقون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: So the word of our Lord has come into effect upon us; indeed, we will taste [punishment]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Our Lord’s sentence on us is just and we must all taste the punishment

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And we led you to deviation; indeed, we were deviators
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: We led you astray as we ourselves were astray.’

ayahs.translation_saheeh: So indeed they, that Day, will be sharing in the punishment
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: On that Day they will all share the torment

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed, that is how We deal with the criminals
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: this is how We deal with the guilty

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُوٓاْ إِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمۡ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ يَسۡتَكۡبِرُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا إِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: انهم كانوا اذا قيل لهم لا اله الا الله يستكبرون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed they, when it was said to them, "There is no deity but Allah," were arrogant
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Whenever it was said to them, ‘There is no deity but God,’ they became arrogant

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَيَقُولُونَ أَئِنَّا لَتَارِكُوٓاْ ءَالِهَتِنَا لِشَاعِرࣲ مَّجۡنُونِۭ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَيَقُولُونَ أَئِنَّا لَتَارِكُو آلِهَتِنَا لِشَاعِرٍ مَجْنُونٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ويقولون ائنا لتاركو الهتنا لشاعر مجنون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And were saying, "Are we to leave our gods for a mad poet
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and said, ‘Are we to forsake our gods for a mad poet?’

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Rather, the Prophet has come with the truth and confirmed the [previous] messengers
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: ‘No: he brought the truth and confirmed the earlier messengers

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed, you [disbelievers] will be tasters of the painful punishment
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: you will taste the painful torment

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَمَا تُجۡزَوۡنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَمَا تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: وما تجزون الا ما كنتم تعملون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And you will not be recompensed except for what you used to do
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and be repaid only according to your deeds.’

ayahs.translation_saheeh: But not the chosen servants of Allah
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Not so God’s true servants

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Those will have a provision determined
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: They will have familiar provisions––

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Fruits; and they will be honored
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: fruits- and will be honoured

ayahs.translation_saheeh: In gardens of pleasure
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: in gardens of delight

ayahs.translation_saheeh: On thrones facing one another
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: seated on couches, facing one another

ayahs.translation_saheeh: There will be circulated among them a cup [of wine] from a flowing spring
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: A drink will be passed round among them from a flowing spring

ayahs.translation_saheeh: White and delicious to the drinkers
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: white, delicious to those who taste it

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: لَا فِيهَا غَوۡلࣱ وَلَا هُمۡ عَنۡهَا يُنزَفُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: لَا فِيهَا غَوْلٌ وَلَا هُمْ عَنْهَا يُنْزَفُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: لا فيها غول ولا هم عنها ينزفون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: No bad effect is there in it, nor from it will they be intoxicated
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: causing no headiness or intoxication

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And with them will be women limiting [their] glances, with large, [beautiful] eyes
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: With them will be spouses- modest of gaze and beautiful of eye

ayahs.translation_saheeh: As if they were [delicate] eggs, well-protected
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: like protected eggs

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And they will approach one another, inquiring of each other
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: They will turn to one another with questions

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: قَالَ قَآئِلࣱ مِّنۡهُمۡ إِنِّي كَانَ لِي قَرِينࣱ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: قَالَ قَائِلٌ مِنْهُمْ إِنِّي كَانَ لِي قَرِينٌ
ayahs.arabic_clean: قال قائل منهم اني كان لي قرين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: A speaker among them will say, "Indeed, I had a companion [on earth]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: one will say, ‘I had a close companion on earth

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Who would say, 'Are you indeed of those who believe
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: who used to ask me, “Do you really believe that

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: أَءِذَا مِتۡنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابࣰ ا وَعِظَٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَدِينُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: أَإِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَعِظَامًا أَإِنَّا لَمَدِينُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ااذا متنا وكنا ترابا وعظاما اانا لمدينون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: That when we have died and become dust and bones, we will indeed be recompensed
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: after we die and become dust and bone, we shall be brought for judgement?”’

ayahs.translation_saheeh: He will say, "Would you [care to] look
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Then he will say, ‘Shall we look for him?’

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And he will look and see him in the midst of the Hellfire
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: He will look down and see him in the midst of the Fire

ayahs.translation_saheeh: He will say, "By Allah, you almost ruined me
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and say to him, ‘By God, you almost brought me to ruin

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَلَوۡلَا نِعۡمَةُ رَبِّي لَكُنتُ مِنَ ٱلۡمُحۡضَرِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَلَوْلَا نِعْمَةُ رَبِّي لَكُنْتُ مِنَ الْمُحْضَرِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ولولا نعمة ربي لكنت من المحضرين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: If not for the favor of my Lord, I would have been of those brought in [to Hell]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Had it not been for the grace of my Lord, I too would have been taken to Hell.’

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Then, are we not to die
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Then he will say [to his blessed companions], ‘Are we never to die again after our earlier death

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: إِلَّا مَوۡتَتَنَا ٱلۡأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحۡنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: إِلَّا مَوْتَتَنَا الْأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: الا موتتنا الاولى وما نحن بمعذبين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Except for our first death, and we will not be punished
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Shall we never suffer

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed, this is the great attainment
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: This truly is the supreme triumph!’

ayahs.translation_saheeh: For the like of this let the workers [on earth] work
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Everyone should strive to attain this

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: أَذَٰلِكَ خَيۡرࣱ نُّزُلًا أَمۡ شَجَرَةُ ٱلزَّقُّومِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: أَذَٰلِكَ خَيْرٌ نُزُلًا أَمْ شَجَرَةُ الزَّقُّومِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: اذلك خير نزلا ام شجرة الزقوم
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Is Paradise a better accommodation or the tree of zaqqum
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Is this the better welcome, or the tree of Zaqqum

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed, We have made it a torment for the wrongdoers
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: which we have made a test for the evildoers

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: إِنَّهَا شَجَرَةࣱ تَخۡرُجُ فِيٓ أَصۡلِ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: إِنَّهَا شَجَرَةٌ تَخْرُجُ فِي أَصْلِ الْجَحِيمِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: انها شجرة تخرج في اصل الجحيم
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed, it is a tree issuing from the bottom of the Hellfire
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: This tree grows in the heart of the blazing Fire

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Its emerging fruit as if it was heads of the devils
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and its fruits are like devils’ heads

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فَإِنَّهُمۡ لَأٓكِلُونَ مِنۡهَا فَمَالِـُٔونَ مِنۡهَا ٱلۡبُطُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: فَإِنَّهُمْ لَآكِلُونَ مِنْهَا فَمَالِئُونَ مِنْهَا الْبُطُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: فانهم لاكلون منها فمالئون منها البطون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And indeed, they will eat from it and fill with it their bellies
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: They will fill their bellies eating from it

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: ثُمَّ إِنَّ لَهُمۡ عَلَيۡهَا لَشَوۡبࣰ ا مِّنۡ حَمِيمࣲ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: ثُمَّ إِنَّ لَهُمْ عَلَيْهَا لَشَوْبًا مِنْ حَمِيمٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ثم ان لهم عليها لشوبا من حميم
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Then indeed, they will have after it a mixture of scalding water
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: then drink scalding water on top of it

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Then indeed, their return will be to the Hellfire
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: then return to the blazing Fire

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed they found their fathers astray
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: They found their forefathers astray

ayahs.translation_saheeh: So they hastened [to follow] in their footsteps
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and rushed to follow in their footsteps- before the disbelievers [of Mecca]

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And there had already strayed before them most of the former peoples
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: most men in the past went astray

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And We had already sent among them warners
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: even though We sent messengers to warn them

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Then look how was the end of those who were warned
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: See how those who were warned met their end

ayahs.translation_saheeh: But not the chosen servants of Allah
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Not so the true servants of God

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And Noah had certainly called Us, and [We are] the best of responders
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Noah cried to Us, and how excellent was Our response

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And We saved him and his family from the great affliction
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: We saved him and his people from great distress

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And We made his descendants those remaining [on the earth]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: We let his offspring remain on the earth

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And left for him [favorable mention] among later generations
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: We let him be praised by later generations

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Peace upon Noah among the worlds
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: ‘Peace be upon Noah among all the nations!’

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: This is how We reward those who do good

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed, he was of Our believing servants
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: he was truly one of Our faithful servants

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Then We drowned the disbelievers
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: We drowned the rest

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And indeed, among his kind was Abraham
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Abraham was of the same faith

ayahs.translation_saheeh: When he came to his Lord with a sound heart
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: he came to his Lord with a devoted heart

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: إِذۡ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوۡمِهِۦ مَاذَا تَعۡبُدُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِ مَاذَا تَعْبُدُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: اذ قال لابيه وقومه ماذا تعبدون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: [And] when he said to his father and his people, "What do you worship
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: He said to his father and his people, ‘What are you worshipping

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Is it falsehood [as] gods other than Allah you desire
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: How can you choose false gods instead of the true God

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Then what is your thought about the Lord of the worlds
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: So what is your opinion about the Lord of all the Worlds?’

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And he cast a look at the stars
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: then he looked up to the stars

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And said, "Indeed, I am [about to be] ill
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: He said, ‘I am sick,’

ayahs.translation_saheeh: So they turned away from him, departing
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: so [his people] turned away from him and left

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ ءَالِهَتِهِمۡ فَقَالَ أَلَا تَأۡكُلُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰ آلِهَتِهِمْ فَقَالَ أَلَا تَأْكُلُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: فراغ الى الهتهم فقال الا تاكلون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Then he turned to their gods and said, "Do you not eat
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: He turned to their gods and said

ayahs.translation_saheeh: What is [wrong] with you that you do not speak
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: ‘Do you not eat? Why do you not speak?’

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And he turned upon them a blow with [his] right hand
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: then he turned and struck them with his right arm

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Then the people came toward him, hastening
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: His people hurried towards him

ayahs.translation_saheeh: He said, "Do you worship that which you [yourselves] carve
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: but he said, ‘How can you worship things you carve with your own hands

ayahs.translation_saheeh: While Allah created you and that which you do
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: when it is God who has created you and all your handiwork?’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: قَالُواْ ٱبۡنُواْ لَهُۥ بُنۡيَٰنࣰ ا فَأَلۡقُوهُ فِي ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: قَالُوا ابْنُوا لَهُ بُنْيَانًا فَأَلْقُوهُ فِي الْجَحِيمِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: قالوا ابنوا له بنيانا فالقوه في الجحيم
ayahs.translation_saheeh: They said, "Construct for him a furnace and throw him into the burning fire
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: They said, ‘Build a pyre and throw him into the blazing fire.’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فَأَرَادُواْ بِهِۦ كَيۡدࣰ ا فَجَعَلۡنَٰهُمُ ٱلۡأَسۡفَلِينَ
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And they intended for him a plan, but We made them the most debased
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: They wanted to harm him, but We humiliated them

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَقَالَ إِنِّي ذَاهِبٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّي سَيَهۡدِينِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَقَالَ إِنِّي ذَاهِبٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّي سَيَهْدِينِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: وقال اني ذاهب الى ربي سيهدين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And [then] he said, "Indeed, I will go to [where I am ordered by] my Lord; He will guide me
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: He said, ‘I will go to my Lord: He is sure to guide me

ayahs.translation_saheeh: My Lord, grant me [a child] from among the righteous
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Lord, grant me a righteous son,’

ayahs.translation_saheeh: So We gave him good tidings of a forbearing boy
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: so We gave him the good news that he would have a patient son

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ مَعَهُ ٱلسَّعۡيَ قَالَ يَٰبُنَيَّ إِنِّيٓ أَرَىٰ فِي ٱلۡمَنَامِ أَنِّيٓ أَذۡبَحُكَ فَٱنظُرۡ مَاذَا تَرَىٰۚ قَالَ يَٰٓأَبَتِ ٱفۡعَلۡ مَا تُؤۡمَرُۖ سَتَجِدُنِيٓ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰبِرِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ مَعَهُ السَّعْيَ قَالَ يَا بُنَيَّ إِنِّي أَرَىٰ فِي الْمَنَامِ أَنِّي أَذْبَحُكَ فَانْظُرْ مَاذَا تَرَىٰ ۚ قَالَ يَا أَبَتِ افْعَلْ مَا تُؤْمَرُ ۖ سَتَجِدُنِي إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ مِنَ الصَّابِرِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: فلما بلغ معه السعي قال يا بني اني ارى في المنام اني اذبحك فانظر ماذا ترى ۚ قال يا ابت افعل ما تؤمر ۖ ستجدني ان شاء الله من الصابرين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And when he reached with him [the age of] exertion, he said, "O my son, indeed I have seen in a dream that I [must] sacrifice you, so see what you think." He said, "O my father, do as you are commanded. You will find me, if Allah wills, of the steadfast
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: When the boy was old enough to work with his father, Abraham said, ‘My son, I have seen myself sacrificing you in a dream. What do you think?’ He said, ‘Father, do as you are commanded and, God willing, you will find me steadfast.’

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And when they had both submitted and he put him down upon his forehead
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: When they had both submitted to God, and he had laid his son down on the side of his face

ayahs.translation_saheeh: We called to him, "O Abraham
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: We called out to him, ‘Abraham

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: قَدۡ صَدَّقۡتَ ٱلرُّءۡيَآۚ إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: قَدْ صَدَّقْتَ الرُّؤْيَا ۚ إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِي الْمُحْسِنِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: قد صدقت الرؤيا ۚ انا كذلك نجزي المحسنين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: You have fulfilled the vision." Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: you have fulfilled the dream.’ This is how We reward those who do good

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed, this was the clear trial
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: it was a test to prove [their true characters]

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And We ransomed him with a great sacrifice
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: We ransomed his son with a momentous sacrifice

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And We left for him [favorable mention] among later generations
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and We let him be praised by succeeding generations

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Peace upon Abraham
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: ‘Peace be upon Abraham!’

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: This is how We reward those who do good

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed, he was of Our believing servants
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: truly he was one of Our faithful servants

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَبَشَّرۡنَٰهُ بِإِسۡحَٰقَ نَبِيࣰّ ا مِّنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And We gave him good tidings of Isaac, a prophet from among the righteous
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: We gave Abraham the good news of Isaac- a prophet and a righteous man

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَبَٰرَكۡنَا عَلَيۡهِ وَعَلَىٰٓ إِسۡحَٰقَۚ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِهِمَا مُحۡسِنࣱ وَظَالِمࣱ لِّنَفۡسِهِۦ مُبِينࣱ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَبَارَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَىٰ إِسْحَاقَ ۚ وَمِنْ ذُرِّيَّتِهِمَا مُحْسِنٌ وَظَالِمٌ لِنَفْسِهِ مُبِينٌ
ayahs.arabic_clean: وباركنا عليه وعلى اسحاق ۚ ومن ذريتهما محسن وظالم لنفسه مبين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And We blessed him and Isaac. But among their descendants is the doer of good and the clearly unjust to himself
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and blessed him and Isaac too: some of their offspring were good, but some clearly wronged themselves

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And We did certainly confer favor upon Moses and Aaron
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: We also bestowed Our favour on Moses and Aaron

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And We saved them and their people from the great affliction
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: We saved them and their people from great distress

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And We supported them so it was they who overcame
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: We helped them, so they were the ones to succeed

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And We gave them the explicit Scripture
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: We gave them the Scripture that makes things clear

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And We guided them on the straight path
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: We guided them to the right path

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And We left for them [favorable mention] among later generations
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: We let them be praised by succeeding generations

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Peace upon Moses and Aaron
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: ‘Peace be upon Moses and Aaron!’

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: This is how We reward those who do good

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed, they were of Our believing servants
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: truly they were among Our faithful servants

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And indeed, Elias was from among the messengers
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Elijah too was one of the messengers

ayahs.translation_saheeh: When he said to his people, "Will you not fear Allah
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: He said to his people, ‘Have you no fear of God

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: أَتَدۡعُونَ بَعۡلࣰ ا وَتَذَرُونَ أَحۡسَنَ ٱلۡخَٰلِقِينَ
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Do you call upon Ba'l and leave the best of creators
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: How can you invoke Baal and forsake the Most Gracious Creator

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Allah, your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: God, your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers?’

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And they denied him, so indeed, they will be brought [for punishment]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: but they rejected him. They will be brought to punishment as a consequence

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Except the chosen servants of Allah
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: not so the true servants of God

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And We left for him [favorable mention] among later generations
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: We let him be praised by succeeding generations

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Peace upon Elias
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: ‘Peace be to Elijah!’

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: This is how We reward those who do good

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed, he was of Our believing servants
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: truly he was one of Our faithful servants

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And indeed, Lot was among the messengers
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Lot was also one of the messengers

ayahs.translation_saheeh: [So mention] when We saved him and his family, all
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: We saved him and all his family

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Except his wife among those who remained [with the evildoers]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: except for an old woman who stayed behind

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Then We destroyed the others
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and We destroyed the rest

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And indeed, you pass by them in the morning
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: You [people] pass by their ruins morning

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And at night. Then will you not use reason
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and night: will you not take heed

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And indeed, Jonah was among the messengers
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Jonah too was one of the messengers

ayahs.translation_saheeh: [Mention] when he ran away to the laden ship
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: He fled to the overloaded ship

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And he drew lots and was among the losers
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: They cast lots, he suffered defeat

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Then the fish swallowed him, while he was blameworthy
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and a great fish swallowed him, for he had committed blameworthy acts

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And had he not been of those who exalt Allah
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: If he had not been one of those who glorified God

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: لَلَبِثَ فِي بَطۡنِهِۦٓ إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ يُبۡعَثُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: لَلَبِثَ فِي بَطْنِهِ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: للبث في بطنه الى يوم يبعثون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: He would have remained inside its belly until the Day they are resurrected
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: he would have stayed in its belly until the Day when all are raised up

ayahs.translation_saheeh: But We threw him onto the open shore while he was ill
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: but We cast him out, sick, on to a barren shore

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And We caused to grow over him a gourd vine
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and made a gourd tree grow above him

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَأَرۡسَلۡنَٰهُ إِلَىٰ مِاْئَةِ أَلۡفٍ أَوۡ يَزِيدُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَأَرْسَلْنَاهُ إِلَىٰ مِائَةِ أَلْفٍ أَوْ يَزِيدُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: وارسلناه الى مائة الف او يزيدون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And We sent him to [his people of] a hundred thousand or more
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: We sent him to a hundred thousand people or more

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And they believed, so We gave them enjoyment [of life] for a time
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: They believed, so We let them live out their lives

ayahs.translation_saheeh: So inquire of them, [O Muhammad], "Does your Lord have daughters while they have sons
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Now [Muhammad], ask the disbelievers: is it true that your Lord has daughters, while they choose sons for themselves

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: أَمۡ خَلَقۡنَا ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ إِنَٰثࣰ ا وَهُمۡ شَٰهِدُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: أَمْ خَلَقْنَا الْمَلَائِكَةَ إِنَاثًا وَهُمْ شَاهِدُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ام خلقنا الملائكة اناثا وهم شاهدون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Or did We create the angels as females while they were witnesses
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Did We create the angels as females while they were watching

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Unquestionably, it is out of their [invented] falsehood that they say
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: No indeed! It is one of their lies when they say

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Allah has begotten," and indeed, they are liars
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: ‘God has begotten.’ How they lie

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Has He chosen daughters over sons
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Did He truly choose daughters in preference to sons

ayahs.translation_saheeh: What is [wrong] with you? How do you make judgement
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: What is the matter with you? How do you form your judgements

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Then will you not be reminded
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Do you not reflect

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Or do you have a clear authority
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Do you perhaps have clear authority

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Then produce your scripture, if you should be truthful
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Bring your scriptures, if you are telling the truth

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَجَعَلُواْ بَيۡنَهُۥ وَبَيۡنَ ٱلۡجِنَّةِ نَسَبࣰ اۚ وَلَقَدۡ عَلِمَتِ ٱلۡجِنَّةُ إِنَّهُمۡ لَمُحۡضَرُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَجَعَلُوا بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ الْجِنَّةِ نَسَبًا ۚ وَلَقَدْ عَلِمَتِ الْجِنَّةُ إِنَّهُمْ لَمُحْضَرُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: وجعلوا بينه وبين الجنة نسبا ۚ ولقد علمت الجنة انهم لمحضرون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And they have claimed between Him and the jinn a lineage, but the jinn have already known that they [who made such claims] will be brought to [punishment]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: They claim that He has kinship with the jinn, yet the jinn themselves know that they will be brought before Him

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Exalted is Allah above what they describe
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: God is far above what they attribute to Him

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Except the chosen servants of Allah [who do not share in that sin]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: the true servants of God do not do such things

ayahs.translation_saheeh: So indeed, you [disbelievers] and whatever you worship
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and neither you nor what you worship

ayahs.translation_saheeh: You cannot tempt [anyone] away from Him
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: can lure away from God any

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Except he who is to [enter and] burn in the Hellfire
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: except those who will burn in Hell

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَمَا مِنَّآ إِلَّا لَهُۥ مَقَامࣱ مَّعۡلُومࣱ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَمَا مِنَّا إِلَّا لَهُ مَقَامٌ مَعْلُومٌ
ayahs.arabic_clean: وما منا الا له مقام معلوم
ayahs.translation_saheeh: [The angels say], "There is not among us any except that he has a known position
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: [The angels say], ‘Every single one of us has his appointed place

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And indeed, we are those who line up [for prayer]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: we are ranged in ranks

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And indeed, we are those who exalt Allah
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: We glorify God.’

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And indeed, the disbelievers used to say
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: [The disbelievers] used to say

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: لَوۡ أَنَّ عِندَنَا ذِكۡرࣰ ا مِّنَ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: لَوْ أَنَّ عِنْدَنَا ذِكْرًا مِنَ الْأَوَّلِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: لو ان عندنا ذكرا من الاولين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: If we had a message from [those of] the former peoples
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: ‘If only we had a scripture like previous people

ayahs.translation_saheeh: We would have been the chosen servants of Allah
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: we would be true servants of God,’

ayahs.translation_saheeh: But they disbelieved in it, so they are going to know
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: yet now they reject [the Quran]. They will soon realize

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And Our word has already preceded for Our servants, the messengers
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Our word has already been given to Our servants the messengers

ayahs.translation_saheeh: [That] indeed, they would be those given victory
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: it is they who will be helped

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And [that] indeed, Our soldiers will be those who overcome
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and the ones who support Our cause will be the winners

ayahs.translation_saheeh: So, [O Muhammad], leave them for a time
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: So [Prophet] turn away from the disbelievers for a while

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And see [what will befall] them, for they are going to see
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Watch them: they will soon see

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Then for Our punishment are they impatient
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Do they really wish to hasten Our punishment

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فَإِذَا نَزَلَ بِسَاحَتِهِمۡ فَسَآءَ صَبَاحُ ٱلۡمُنذَرِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: فَإِذَا نَزَلَ بِسَاحَتِهِمْ فَسَاءَ صَبَاحُ الْمُنْذَرِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: فاذا نزل بساحتهم فساء صباح المنذرين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: But when it descends in their territory, then evil is the morning of those who were warned
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: When it descends on their courtyards, how ter-rible that morning will be for those who were warned

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And leave them for a time
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: [Prophet], turn away from the disbelievers for a while

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And see, for they are going to see
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Watch them: they will soon see

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: سُبۡحَٰنَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ ٱلۡعِزَّةِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: سُبْحَانَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ الْعِزَّةِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: سبحان ربك رب العزة عما يصفون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Exalted is your Lord, the Lord of might, above what they describe
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Your Lord, the Lord of Glory, is far above what they attribute to Him

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And peace upon the messengers
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Peace be upon the messengers

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And praise to Allah, Lord of the worlds
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and praise be to God the Lord of all the Worlds
